title: Discourse record
description: Substrate spec §4. One record per line in <edition>/15_structured/discourse.jsonl. Soft observations (Reddit/reviews/blogs) anchored to entities; precise claims are lifted into triples.jsonl and back-linked via lifted_claims.

anchors.description: entity ids this observation attaches to (§2.1)

audience.description: freeform audience tags, e.g. first-timer, veteran, parent_with_kid, solo_budget, accessibility_user, international_traveler, crew_lead

lifted_claims.description: ids/refs of triples extracted from this content (triples.jsonl)
